attributes.name: Chelish Marine Captain
attributes.powers:
Before you act, recharge 2 cards, then summon and encounter a random ship.

After you act, the Chelish Marine Captain deals 1d4+1 Structural damage to your ship. 

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
